final: WITH counts AS (SELECT p.player_id, COUNT(ma.player_id) AS award_count FROM player AS p LEFT JOIN manager_award AS ma ON p.player_id = ma.player_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY p.player_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(award_count) AS award_total FROM counts) SELECT counts.player_id, counts.award_count, CAST(counts.award_count AS REAL) / total.award_total FROM counts JOIN total ON total.award_total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(counts.award_count AS REAL) / total.award_total DESC LIMIT 10
